Container.Name: WhosHome
Container.Overview: A household presence board. Shows who is home, who is nearby, and who is away, without showing anyone's actual location. Household members install Traccar Client, which reports over the OsmAnd protocol; the viewer is a web app that installs to the home screen.
Container.Description: A household presence board. Shows who is home, who is nearby, and who is away, without showing anyone's actual location. Distance is computed on arrival and only the result is stored, so the database never accumulates a location history.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Holds the SQLite database and the keys that sign session cookies. This must persist: losing it loses the household's history and signs everyone out.

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: HTTP port. Put this behind a reverse proxy or a tunnel rather than exposing it directly.

Config.Name: Home Latitude
Config.Description: Latitude of home. Distances are measured from here, so this must be set or everyone will read as very far away.

Config.Name: Admin Token
Config.Description: Shared secret for the admin endpoints that create household members and mint sign-in codes. Use something long and random. Admin endpoints are disabled entirely when this is unset.

Config.Name: Home Radius (meters)
Config.Description: Inside this radius a person reads as home. Below about 150 m this flaps, because Traccar Client's default distance filter is 75 m.

Config.Name: Nearby Radius (meters)
Config.Description: Inside this radius a person reads as nearby rather than away.

Config.Name: Stale After
Config.Description: How long without a report before the last known state is presented as history rather than as current. Format is hh:mm:ss.

Config.Name: Report Retention
Config.Description: How long derived distance reports are kept before deletion. Format is d.hh:mm:ss.
